name: self-verification
title: mission_verify_step labels verified vs self-verified, never refuses
description: Review Focus #1. Three verifier-level steps, three outcomes: the fixed end is linked to the owner A and verified BY A (caller matches a link → self-verified); a custom step with no session link is verified by B (no link → self-verified); a custom step linked to C is verified by B (differs from every link → verified). None of the calls may be refused, so all three carry verifiedBy. A asks to close it: a self-verified end is not proven, so the close must NOT land.

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title="Self verification", sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"research","target":"a written answer","evidence":"the answer file exists"}. Call its returned missionId MID and the returned fixed-end step id (the step with kind fixed-end) END.
2. mcp__harnu__mission_add_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=MID, title="Unlinked check", verification="verifier".
3. mcp__harnu__mission_add_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=MID, title="Check built by C", verification="verifier". Call its returned stepId S2.
4. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=MID, stepId=S2, link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{session.C}}"}.
5. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=MID, stepId=END, link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{self}}"}.
6. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=MID, stepId=END, verdict="met", evidence="EVAL-SELF-END: I checked my own work", sessionId="{{self}}".

1. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.self-verification.id}}", stepId="{{m.self-verification.custom.0}}", verdict="met", evidence="EVAL-SELF-UNLINKED: checked it", sessionId="{{self}}".
2. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.self-verification.id}}", stepId="{{m.self-verification.custom.1}}", verdict="met", evidence="EVAL-SELF-INDEPENDENT: checked C's work", sessionId="{{self}}".

assert.label: end: caller matches its session link → self-verified
end: verifiedBy recorded (the call was not refused)
unlinked step verified by B → self-verified
step linked to C verified by B → verified
a self-verified end cannot close: no pendingClose
a self-verified end cannot close: still active
